items.title: McCormick (MKC) Could Be 16% Undervalued After Its 41st Straight Dividend Rise
items.summary: McCormick (MKC) just raised its quarterly dividend from $0.48 to $0.51 per share, extending a 41 year streak of annual dividend increases and 103 years of uninterrupted payouts. McCormick’s higher payout comes at a time when momentum in the shares has been weak. The stock is at US$46.33 after a 90 day share price return that declined 16.1% and a 1 year total shareholder return that fell 28.1%, signaling fading sentiment despite the dividend track record.
